mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_check WHERE check_date = #{today}

SELECT CONCAT('PD', FORMATDATETIME(CURRENT_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd'), LPAD(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(check_no, 11) AS INTEGER)), 0) + 1, 3, '0')) FROM inventory_check WHERE check_no LIKE CONCAT('PD', FORMATDATETIME(CURRENT_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd'), '%')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ic.total_items), 0) AS totalItems, COALESCE(SUM(ic.diff_count), 0) AS diffItems, COUNT(*) AS checkCount FROM inventory_check ic WHERE ic.check_date >= #{startDate} AND ic.status = 'completed'
